description: Search the General Optical Council's public Specialist Register (str.optical.org) for registered optometrists, dispensing opticians, students, and optical businesses across the UK.

address.description: Filter registrants by address text (contains match).
address.title: Address contains (mode=registrant)

companyName.description: Filter optical businesses whose registered name contains this text.
companyName.title: Company name contains (mode=bodyCorporate)

fetchDetails.description: Visit each registrant/business detail page to also capture qualifications, town, practice address, and fitness-to-practise decisions. Slower but much richer records. Disable for a faster, list-only run.
fetchDetails.title: Fetch full profile details

forename.description: Filter registrants by first name (contains match).
forename.title: First name (mode=registrant)

gocNumbers.description: Exact-match one or more GOC registration numbers (e.g. `01-12294` for a registrant or `CO-4310` for a business). Overrides name-based search when provided.
gocNumbers.title: GOC number(s)

maxItems.description: Hard cap on the number of records returned.
maxItems.title: Max items

mode.description: Search individual registrants (optometrists/dispensing opticians) or registered optical businesses (body corporates).
mode.title: Mode

postcode.description: UK postcode to search around. Combined with `radiusMiles`. Works for both registrants and businesses.
postcode.title: Postcode (geography search)

radiusMiles.description: Distance in miles from `postcode` to search within. Only used when `postcode` is set.
radiusMiles.title: Radius in miles (geography search)

registerType.description: Restrict to a specific registration category.
registerType.title: Registered as (mode=registrant)

soundsLikeSurname.description: When enabled, `surname` is matched phonetically (e.g. 'Smyth' also matches 'Smith') instead of as a literal substring.
soundsLikeSurname.title: Sounds-like surname match (mode=registrant)

speciality.description: Restrict to registrants holding a specific specialty annotation.
speciality.title: Specialty (mode=registrant)

surname.description: Filter registrants whose surname contains this text. Case-insensitive, matches anywhere in the surname.
surname.title: Surname contains (mode=registrant)

title: UK Optician Register Scraper Input
